start.text: You hold the silvered lamp close. It hums with three months of somebody else's nights, and the edges of them come:
Cold on the rock. The lamp out low over the water, the arm aching with it. The singing all round, a great many voices, and one of them nearer than the rest.
She's tired. She's been at it so long. She nearly has it. You lean toward her with somebody else's whole body.
It isn't yours to listen to for long. The lamp is cold in your hand again.
